title: Titanium Mist Eliminator Frame
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for Titanium Mist Eliminator Frame where formability and corrosion resistance are prioritized over absolute strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, Grade 2 CP-Ti forms a stable TiO₂ passive film that provides immunity to pitting in chloride environments up to 260°C. Its 345 MPa yield strength with 30% elongation makes it ideal for Mist eliminator demister grid frame requiring cold forming or bending without cracking. This rationale is driven by mist eliminator demister grid frame and fat life requirements.
process: CNC machining from plate for wastewater geometry
TIG welding all-position for net-shape tolerance
Passivation DI rinse for net-shape tolerance
surfaceTreatment: Pickling HF-HNO3 bath + passivation to restore passive film integrity on welded/seamed process surfaces — tailored for mist eliminator demister application
commonFailures: Biofouling accumulation on stagnant surfaces - reduced by smooth surface finish Ra <0.8um and regular CIP — critical for mist eliminator demister performance

faq.q: What pH range can Titanium Mist Eliminator Frame withstand in effluent streams?
faq.a: Grade 2 CP-Ti maintains corrosion rates below 0.05 mm/year across pH 2-12 at 40°C in chloride-containing effluents. For mist eliminator demister handling acidic or alkaline waste streams, titanium eliminates the need for polymer linings or acid-resistant brick, reducing maintenance costs by approximately 60% over the 10-year design life.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Mist Eliminator Frame?
faq.a: Each Titanium Mist Eliminator Frame shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for mist eliminator demister.
